presentation-solution.name: Solution overview
presentation-solution.desc: Brand films: introduce Leopardo to the general public, from the 90-second flagship film to the short advertising cuts.

verticales.name: Verticals
verticales.desc: One film per activatable business pack: restaurant, travel agency, pharmacy, hospitality, healthcare, school, fuel station, ride-hailing.

V1.name: Flagship film and advertising cuts
V1.goal: Set the master message and extract the paid formats from it. Everything else depends on it.
V1.rationale: The 90-second film fixes the vocabulary, the shots and the music. The 30-second and 15-second cuts are edited from the same footage, so they cost almost nothing extra.

V2.name: Highest-demand verticals
V2.goal: Cover the business packs that are already the most requested, to feed the pack pages of the site.
V2.rationale: Restaurant, travel, pharmacy and hospitality share the same field setting: one shooting plan covers four films.

V3.name: Remaining verticals
V3.goal: Complete the business pack grid, including the two verticals added in v2.
V3.rationale: Healthcare, school, fuel station and ride-hailing close the historical grid. Farm OS and International Trade OS land here: their interfaces are the most recent.

V4.name: User roles
V4.goal: Speak to the person, not the sector: one film per role.
V4.rationale: These films are shot after the verticals: they reuse the same interfaces, but from a role's point of view. Shooting them earlier would mean shooting them twice.

V5.name: Product films
V5.goal: Explain the four capabilities that make the difference against a spreadsheet.
V5.rationale: Multi-country payroll, offline attendance, accounting and the AI assistant need captures validated by the product team, which is why they come after the verticals.

V6.name: Short formats and social
V6.goal: Feed TikTok, Reels, Shorts and LinkedIn with vertical formats.
V6.rationale: The 9:16 hooks are calibrated on the performance of the previous waves. The customer testimonial requires a client's written consent.

VID-01.title: Leopardo — payroll and time tracking for your field teams (flagship film)
VID-01.objective: Make people understand in 90 seconds that Leopardo solves one precise problem: prove the hours and pay right. The business suite appears in the second half only, as an activatable catalogue, never as the hook. Master film from which the 30-second and 15-second cuts derive.
VID-01.hook: Your timesheets on paper. Your payroll on a spreadsheet. And by evening, an hours dispute nobody can settle.
VID-01.cta: Try free for 14 days on kitokoh.github.io/leopardo-hr, or book a demo.

beats.vo: Every morning your teams clock in on paper. Your payroll is calculated on a spreadsheet. And when an employee contests his hours, nobody can prove anything.
Leopardo brings payroll and time tracking for your field teams into a single application.
Clock-in comes from mobile, GPS or the ZKTeco biometric kiosk. When the network drops, the terminal keeps running and resyncs as soon as the link returns.
Algerian payroll applies: IRG, CNAS, attendance and leave variables pulled in, payslip generated as PDF, run locked once validated.
The employee record, the contract, leave and documents are entered once and used everywhere.
beats.text: The employee record feeds everything else.

beats.vo: And because your business does not stop at payroll: accounting, CRM, and activatable business packs when you need them.
Fourteen days free, no credit card. Set up in under thirty minutes.

VID-01.audience: Hands-on SME owners and accounting firms, Algeria first
